weak_fit_review.note: Verdicts from audit/weak-fit-review.md. 97 report flags resolved to 7 decisions: 90 were in reserve tables a visitor never sees.

paris_manufacturing.note: Supersedes the 2026-09-21 verdict that Paris manufacturing was intentionally left at 4 primary picks because on-theme data was not offered in AWS_EU_WEST_3. A re-run of curate_locality.py --profile fr --industry manufacturing against AWS_EU_WEST_3 returned 6 on-theme, Free, is_ready_for_import listings, so the scarcity claim was too strong - the earlier run simply found less. The six were hand-merged rather than taken as the search returned them: CEIC Commodities Data was restored (a prior primary the re-run dropped) and the sixth slot went to the EU + UK B2B Company Database, which answers the script's own 'company and supplier registries' angle. Two weak-fit results were demoted to reserve - Hydrogen price data (too niche) and World Points of Interest Premium France (duplicates the France POI 19 Industry set). Franciemes IRIS stays deleted per the earlier review. Paris now matches London and Berlin at 6 primary. Follow-up measurement: the review also claimed Industry Classification Systems does not appear in the Paris catalogue at all. That is wrong - SHOW AVAILABLE LISTINGS reports it available in AWS_EU_WEST_3 and is_ready_for_import, and it is a primary in both London and Berlin, so it was swapped into Paris in place of European Gas Analytics, which reads as energy rather than manufacturing. The review was correct about the other two London picks: FactSet Supply Chain Relationships and Overture Maps - Transportation are genuinely not offered in AWS_EU_WEST_3.

region_audit.how: scripts/audit_marketplace_regions.py against SHOW AVAILABLE LISTINGS, each profile judged on its OWN event region
region_audit.note: No curated pick is withdrawn and none is missing from its own event region - 0 of 288 on both counts, so the curation itself is sound. Three real defects were fixed. A Paris manufacturing primary was is_by_request, meaning the visitor must ask the provider and wait rather than import; it was replaced with Chemical Price Assessments, which covers the same input-cost ground and is directly importable, and the by-request pick moved to the back of reserve. Two further by-request reserves were sunk to the back of their stalls. Nine reserves were labelled Paid, contradicting the rule that nothing Paid ships; they were dropped rather than replaced, because a shorter reserve list is honest where padding with off-theme picks would not be. is_ready_for_import is deliberately NOT used as a cross-region signal: it reports whether THIS account can import, so from a Frankfurt booth account it marks perfectly good London picks unavailable. Judging London on it would bin listings a London visitor could import without trouble.
region_audit.borrowing_note: CORRECTION. An earlier pass sank by-request picks to the back of reserve on the assumption a reserve is only seen when a primary is filtered out. That is false: a stall borrows across industries within the profile, so any curated pick can be served in any stall. Measured - a Paris ENERGY visitor was offered two listings that existed only in manufacturing/reserve, both by-request. Every by-request and discover-only listing is therefore removed from the curated set outright, and the audit now treats every pick as visitor-facing rather than grading reserves as lower severity.
